    CatchUp · Built for the unread problem.Made to give you time back.

    Your chat belongs to you.

    CatchUp processes your text in this browser. Our app has no chat upload server or analytics tracker.

    The optional AI downloads model and runtime files from Hugging Face and jsDelivr. Your chat text is processed on this device.

    Chats stay in memory unless you choose to remember them. A saved chat is stored in this browser profile, without encryption. “Forget saved chat” removes that saved copy.

    AI may miss details. Each source-backed point links to its original message so you can check it.
